title: Hostapleri!
body: Ovo je najgori soft koji postoji prevaranti i lopovi. Skidaju novac sami , evo drugi mjesec po 50 $ skidaju mi sa racuna. title: Please respond to email inquiry
body:
I wanted to test this app and paid for 3months, but by mistake I paid an add on. According to the rules, I can ask for a refund whenever and without any reason. I sent an email, received an automatic respond that someone will reach out to me in 24h, now more than 72h passed and nothing happened Please, check email and respond back with a refund! Thank you!

Edit: Today is January 26th, I answered to you email on the same day, and all I received is are two counter offer.
I don’t want counteroffer, I just want refund!
If you don’t have employees, I’m interested in a side gig. :)
author: JVP HR
